title: Vitess: sharded topology (Shards populated with hash-vindex key ranges)
description: Runs `nexus topology vitess`. Populates the Shards table: one row per keyspace shard (-80 / 80-) with its primary + replica tablets and the hash-vindex key range as the slot range.

observe.what: Nodes table (etcd/control/router/tablet roles) + Shards table: -80 + 80-, each primary + 2 replicas, slot range = hash(customer_id) key range
JSON TopologySnapshot with shards[] non-null (2 TopologyShard entries) — the genuinely-sharded showcase

whatProves: VitessAdapter.TopologyAsync emits a populated Shards array (one TopologyShard per keyspace shard), distinguishing the Vitess hash-vindex sharding from non-sharded clusters (Shards null).
